CustomField.description: Custom bundle tracker. Twin Field from Product Option. Bundled Product is used for Billing Schedule Configurator and necessary to identify if a product is a bundle. This field will allow value to copy from Quote Line to Renewal Quote Line to ensure Billing Schedule for Renewals are correct.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: CPQ TwinField feature will copy the field value from QuoteLine to Subscription and Subscription to Renewal QuoteLine.
CustomField.label: Bundled Product
